facts.text: Las Terrazas is a beachfront resort on Ambergris Caye in San Pedro, Belize.
facts.excerpt:
San Pedro, Belize

# Luxury Beachfront Resort in Ambergris Caye

facts.text: The resort has a private white sand beach.
facts.excerpt: Private white sand beachNear Hol Chan Marine Reserve

facts.text: The resort is near Hol Chan Marine Reserve.
facts.excerpt: Private white sand beachNear Hol Chan Marine Reserve

facts.text: The Penthouse has a private plunge pool on its balcony.
facts.excerpt: 2 or 3 bed · Sleeps up to 6Private plunge pool on balconyMore details

facts.text: The Terrazas Luxury Villa has a private rooftop jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: 3 bed · Sleeps 6Private rooftop jacuzziOutdoor dining · Garden viewsMore details

facts.text: The Beach Front Villa sits on the beach, has ocean views and comes with butler service.
facts.excerpt: 3 bed · Sleeps 6On the beach · Butler serviceOcean viewsMore details

facts.text: The Luxury Lagoon Villa faces west, with lagoon sunsets and an open-air terrace.
facts.excerpt: 3 bed · Sleeps 6West-facing · Lagoon sunsetsOpen-air terrace · Steps from the poolMore details

facts.text: Every residence includes a full kitchen or kitchenette.
facts.excerpt: Every residence includes a full kitchen or kitchenette with essentials for daily cooking, plus easy access to on-site dining if you prefer not to cook.

facts.text: The resort has an infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Infinity pool right outside. Morning coffee, bare feet. Good luck leaving.

facts.text: Guests can kayak at sunrise and watch the sunset from the Sky Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Kayaks at sunrise. Sky Lounge at sunset.

facts.text: The resort has the Serenity Spa.
facts.excerpt:
### Serenity Spa

An hour that feels like three

facts.text: Guests can bring their catch and the chef prepares it to order.
facts.excerpt: Bring your catch and the chef prepares it to order

facts.text: A PADI Open Water certification offered through the resort starts at the resort pool and finishes on the Belize Barrier Reef.
facts.excerpt: A PADI certification that starts at the resort pool and finishes on the Belize Barrier Reef. Two half-days, certified for life

facts.text: The private beach has calm, shallow water and the main pool has a gradual entry.
facts.excerpt: The private beach has calm, shallow water that's ideal for younger swimmers, and the main pool has a gradual entry.

facts.text: Cribs, high chairs and pack-and-plays can be arranged on request.
facts.excerpt: we can arrange cribs, high chairs, and pack-and-plays on request

facts.text: Sargassum can appear seasonally, and the team maintains the beach daily.
facts.excerpt: Sargassum (seaweed) can appear seasonally throughout the Caribbean, but our team maintains the beach daily

facts.text: There are no rental cars on Ambergris Caye; the island runs on golf carts, and the resort can arrange a golf cart rental.
facts.excerpt: No rental cars on Ambergris Caye — the island runs on golf carts. We can arrange a golf cart rental for you through the resort.

facts.text: Breakfast is not automatically included but can be added during booking or purchased on-site.
facts.excerpt: Breakfast is not automatically included, but you can add it during booking or purchase on-site.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed, except service animals.
facts.excerpt: We do not allow pets at this time, with the exception of service animals.

facts.text: Green season, May to October, brings warmer weather and occasional rain but fewer crowds.
facts.excerpt: Green season (May to October) brings warmer weather and occasional rain, but also fewer crowds.

facts.text: The resort can help book snorkeling, diving, fishing and mainland excursions.
facts.excerpt: Yes, our team can assist with booking snorkeling, diving, fishing, mainland excursions, and other experiences based on availability and weather.

facts.text: Las Terrazas is part of the LVX Collection of Preferred Hotels.
facts.excerpt: **LVX Collection** Preferred Hotels

facts.text: Transfer from San Pedro is by the resort's private boat from the marina.
facts.excerpt: Our van driver meets you at the airstrip and takes you to the marina, where our private boat brings you to the resort in about 10 minutes.

facts.text: The resort has one of the largest stretches of private white sand beach on Ambergris Caye.
facts.excerpt: Las Terrazas has one of the largest stretches of private white sand beach on Ambergris Caye.

contradictions.note: p1 says the resort is a short walk or golf cart ride from the airport (15-minute flight); p2 says a 20-minute flight then van to the marina and a private boat of about 10 minutes; p2 intro also says 5 minutes by boat from San Pedro
